# data-sa-052 Statistical analysis text comparison task.

## Task Instructions
Perform a t-test to compare the average medical expenses between smokers and non-smokers to determine if smoking status has a significant impact on medical expenses. Use a significance level of 0.05. Based on the p-value, select either "Fail to reject null hypothesis" or "reject null hypothesis" as the result. Provide your results in the following format:
```
{ "T-Statistic": [...], "P-Value": [...], "result": [...]
}
```
